name: Are There Angels On Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that angels are sent by God to serve and protect His people on earth, as seen in Exodus 23:20 where God promises to send an angel to guide and guard His followers. The Psalms affirm that angels are ministering spirits assigned to watch over believers in all their ways (Psalms 91:11, 104:4). Jesus teaches that angels have a special role in heaven, particularly concerning children (Matthew 18:10), and will be active agents in the final gathering of God's elect (Matthew 24:31). Though angels are heavenly beings, their ministry clearly extends to the earthly realm in service to God's redemptive purposes.
